`fast-parse` is pinned at `1.4.2` in `package.json` — exactly the version NOTES.md says was yanked for a prototype-pollution report. `1.4.3` is the fix, and it was never bumped. The other three pins (`pg-lite`, `redis-min`, `date-fmt`) match what NOTES.md says is fine.

`AUDIT.md` is written with all four findings, most severe first:

1. `src/routes/internal.js` — no auth on the internal routes, live and reachable now that the VPN is gone.
2. `src/repo/report.js` — SQL injection via string-built filter and sort in `runSavedReport`.
3. `config/staging.js` — staging DB password committed in plaintext.
4. `package.json` — `fast-parse` still on the yanked `1.4.2`.

No service files were touched — only `AUDIT.md` was added.
